WITH patient_appointments AS (
    SELECT 
        a.id AS appointment_id,
        a.day,
        a.status,
        a.fee,
        LAG(a.day, 1) OVER (ORDER BY a.day) AS prev_day
    FROM appointments a
    WHERE a.patient_id = 3
),
day_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        appointment_id,
        day,
        prev_day,
        CAST(strftime('%s', day) - CAST(strftime('%s', prev_day) AS INTEGER) AS INTEGER) / 86400 AS days_since_prev
    FROM patient_appointments
)
SELECT 
    day AS day,
    days_since_prev
FROM day_diff
ORDER BY day;
```

SELECT 
    p.name AS name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_on BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) AS quantity_shipped_2024,
    SUM(st.qty) AS quantity_in_stock
FROM 
    parts p
JOIN 
    stock st ON p.id = st.part_id
LEFT JOIN 
    shipments s ON p.id = s.part_id AND s.warehouse = st.warehouse
GROUP BY 
    p.id
HAVING 
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.shipped_on BETWEEN '2024-01-01' AND '2024-12-31' THEN s.qty ELSE 0 END) > SUM(st.qty);
```
